items.title: Photographing a Sunflower
items.alt: Black-and-white photographer in a knitted cap and vest aiming a tripod-mounted camera at a potted sunflower.
items.description: Black-and-white photographer in a knitted cap and vest aiming a tripod-mounted camera at a potted sunflower. The complete observation scene suits a classroom nature activity or a personal coloring page.
